VI.description: Property nodes on an IVI session (niRFSA): read and write items in the long catalogue spelling and a short one, on a session constant with no instrument behind it. The driver answers the same error NI's own build of the node answers.

Node.fields: read+Inherent IVI Attributes\3AInstrument Identification\3AModel,write+Vertical\3AReference Level (dBm),read+Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ANumber Of Averages
Node.outputs: Inherent IVI Attributes\3AInstrument Identification\3AModel:4210.Model,Acquisition\3ASpectrum\3ANumber Of Averages:4210.NOA,reference out:4210.reference out,error out:4210.error out
